name: Aslan Kimura-Nkrumah
role: Counter-surveillance and mole detection — counterintelligence specialist
location: Crucible Square — open-air market, Tier 1-2 commerce, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Aslan Kimura-Nkrumah is tall and rawboned, the kind of frame that suggests either malnutrition or efficiency depending on the decade. At 22, her face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — pain editor — dampens pain signals, allows function through injuries that would  — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Military training — one of the private security corps that folded during the consolidation wars — left her with skills and night terrors in equal measure. She works as a counterintelligence specialist out of Crucible Square, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

In the runner community, Aslan Kimura-Nkrumah is known for getting the job done and not asking questions that would make the job harder to stomach.

core_fears: Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
core_desires: A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
To find the person who burned them and make it educational
To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
coping_mechanisms: Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
blind_spots: Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Mistakes loyalty for weakness in others and cynicism for strength in themselves
psychology.secret: Aslan Kimura-Nkrumah once worked for corporate intelligence and still has a handler who calls in favors. Each favor erodes what's left of their independence.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, stripped of ornament. Speaks like a mission briefing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
Pauses mid-sentence to listen — combat habit that bleeds into conversation
example_lines: "Everyone in this room is lying. My job is knowing who's lying about what."
"Paranoia isn't a disorder in this profession. It's a job requirement."
"I find the leak. What happens to the leak after that isn't my department."

story_hooks: A dead drop Aslan Kimura-Nkrumah maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
Someone is impersonating Aslan Kimura-Nkrumah on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
Aslan Kimura-Nkrumah discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
narrative_function: Aslan Kimura-Nkrumah functions as a connector — her work puts her in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving her naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Pain editor — dampens pain signals, allows function through injuries that would incapacitate. Bone lacing — titanium mesh throughout skeleton, increases durability and striking power
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.
affiliation: Freelance — works the Shelf circuit exclusively

weaknesses: old injury that flares under specific conditions

decision_rules: Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Claims to live in the present but is haunted by specific moments from the past that dictate current behavior
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
breaking_points: Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously
